The cores must be manually picked up to count. They do ''not'' appear in the looting window. Cores obtained from the [[Motherlode Maw]], [[Wythien]], and [[Meg]] count for this achievement. While players may claim the lamp at a lower level, the lamp requires 75 Divination to use. Since the lamp ''cannot'' be banked or reclaimed if lost, it is highly recommended to wait until players have 75 Divination before claiming it. Boosts can be used to receive this lamp and complete the achievement.

'''A Place For My Heads''' is an [[Achievements|achievement]] which requires the player to mount all three of [[the Raptor]]'s slayer trophies inside of the [[Guardhouse]] at [[Fort Forinthry]].

The slayer trophies are obtainable by completing [[Slayer/Challenges|slayer challenges]] given by the Raptor. The challenges require the player to kill [[Zemouregal's undead]] in and around the [[Crypt (Wilderness)|Crypt]]. The Raptor can assign Zemouregal's undead as a separate slayer task, but only the special slayer challenge will work to receive the slayer trophy. After the task is completed, players can speak to the Raptor to receive a slayer trophy. Slayer trophies are obtained one at a time (one for each special assignment) and are obtainable in the following order:
